source.note: Kenney train-tram-modern (the kit also has train-tram-classic and train-tram-round). FBX member plus its colormap texture, flattened to 20 colours, as train-bullet. Scaled with the same factor as train-bullet and train-commuter (kit units x 2.26): 5.20 m to the top of the raised pantograph, roof about 3.4 m above the rail (a real Japanese low-floor tram such as Hiroshima Green Mover or Toyama Portram is about 3.6-3.7 m to the roof). Stylized proportions as the other Kenney trains: 6.07 m long and 2.55 m wide (a real single tram car module is ~2.45 m wide; whole low-floor sets are 18-30 m long). Amber body, white lower band, navy roof and skirt, so it reads apart from the white-and-navy bullet train and the silver-and-red commuter train; the pantograph shares the body colour in the source texture, so it is amber too. Static, no clips.
